proposal.utterance: Classify 'agent connectedness' as a kind of entity.

entities.label: AgentConnectedness
entities.rationale: Agent connectedness is a property that inheres in an agent or set of agents — it characterizes the degree or character of relational binding among agents. As a measurable, bearer-dependent property it fits Quality (BFO_0000019) best. It is not a role (no external social grounding that varies independently of the bearer's intrinsic state), not a disposition (it does not ground a capacity to behave in some way), and not a process (it is not an occurrence but a persisting property). Modeling it as a class (common noun denoting a kind) follows Rule 5.

relations.rationale: AgentConnectedness is a subclass of Quality, situating it as a specifically dependent continuant that inheres in one or more agents and characterizes their relational state.

open_questions: Is 'agent connectedness' intended to be a quality of a single agent (e.g., how connected that agent is to others), or is it a quality of a collective or network of agents? This affects whether the bearer is a single material entity or an aggregate.

Is 'agent connectedness' closer to a social/institutional quality (like InstitutionalRecognitionQuality already in the ontology) or a more general relational property applicable beyond legal/institutional contexts? If the former, it may subclass InstitutionalRecognitionQuality.

Could 'agent connectedness' alternatively be a disposition — i.e., a capacity grounded in the agent's structure to enter into or maintain relations? If so, BFO_0000016 (Disposition) would be more appropriate.
Should this class be linked to existing classes such as RelationalCoherence or RelationalStructure in the working ontology?
proposal.rationale_summary: The phrase 'agent connectedness' denotes a kind of property — the relational binding or linkage obtaining among or within agents. As a common noun naming a kind, it is introduced as a class (Rule 5). BFO_0000019 (Quality) is the best fit because connectedness, when understood as a persisting, bearer-dependent, measurable characteristic, is paradigmatically a quality in BFO's sense. Alternative candidates considered: BFO_0000016 (Disposition) if connectedness is understood as a capacity or tendency grounded in internal structure; BFO_0000031 (Generically Dependent Continuant) if it is understood as a pattern or information structure that could be copied or instantiated elsewhere; BFO_0000023 (Role) if it is an externally conferred social function. Without further clarification, Quality is chosen as the most natural reading, but the open questions surface the key ambiguities for user adjudication.
